title: Length of the circuit gate list
statement: Let $F$ be a finite layered Boolean circuit of depth $d$ using only the standard gate operations. For every natural number $m$, the list of gates in the first $m$ layers has length equal to the sum, over $j<m$, of the number of nodes in layer $j+1$ when $j<d$, with each summand taken as zero when $j\ge d$.
